use_fact_cache.description: Enable use of fact caching for the job template.

verbosity.description: Control the level of output ansible will produce as the playbook executes. `0 - Normal`, `1 - Verbose`, `2 - More Verbose`, `3 - Debug`, `4 - r.client.auth Debug`, `5 - WinRM Debug`

webhook_credential.description: Personal Access Token for posting back the status to the service API

webhook_service.description: Service that webhook requests will be accepted from. Either `""`, `bitbucket_dc`, `github`, or `gitlab`

notification_configuration.description: json. This value depends on the `notification_type` chosen. But, the value should be json. E.g. `notification_configuration = jsonencode(blah blah blah)`. The AWX Tower API never returns a value for Token. So, this provider is coded to ignore changes to that field.

notification_type.description: Only `slack` and `webhook` are currently supported in this provider. Choose from: `email`, `grafan`, `irc`, `mattermost`, `pagerduty`, `rocketchat`, `slack`, `twilio`, `webhook`.

organization.description: Organization ID for the notification template.

default_environment.description: The fallback execution environment that will be used for jobs inside of this organization if not explicitly assigned at the project, job template or workflow level.

id.description: Organization ID. If using a provider-level `platform` field value of `aap2.5` then be sure this ID is the controller ID, not the gateway ID.

max_hosts.description: Maximum number of hosts allowed to be managed by this organization.

allow_override.description: Allow changing the Source Control branch or revision in a job template that uses this project.

default_environment.description: The ID of the execution environment that will be used for jobs that use this project.

id.description: A valid project ID. You must specify either the `id` or `name` field, but not both.

local_path.description: Select from the list of directories found in the Project Base Path. Together the base path and the playbook directory provide the full path used to locate playbooks.

name.description: Project name. You must specify either the `id` or `name` field, but not both.

organization.description: Organization ID for the project to live in.

scm_branch.description: The branch name in source control.

scm_clean.description: Remove any local modifications prior to performing an update.

scm_delete_on_update.description: Delete the local repository in its entirety prior to performing an update. Depending on the size of the repository this may significantly increase the amount of time required to complete an update.

scm_refspec.description: The refspec to use for the SCM resource.

scm_track_submodules.description: Track submodules latest commit on specified branch.

scm_update_on_launch.description: Perform an update to the local repository before launching a job with this project.

scm_url.description: Example URLs for Remote Archive Source Control include: `https://github.com/username/project/archive/v0.0.1.tar.gz` `https://github.com/username/project/archive/v0.0.2.zip`

timeout.description: The amount of time (in seconds) to run before the SCM Update is canceled. A value of 0 means no timeout.

id.description: Team ID. Either `id` or `name` required for datasource.

name.description: The name of the team. Either `id` or `name` required for datasource.

id.description: User ID. Either `id` or `username` required for datasource.

is_superuser.description: Designates that this user has all permissions without explicitly assigning them.

is_system_auditor.description: User is a system wide auditor.

password.description: User's password. API will return blank or encrypted.

username.description: The username of the user. Either `id` or `username` required for datasource.
